reviews.title: Wish it were better
reviews.text:
This app used to be really great, but their customer service and treatment is just like any other company. Profits over people. 

I was a paying customer for 10 years and one day they removed my profile with no warning because it stated my profession as an LMT in the “what I do” section of my profile. 

They eventually allowed me to reinstate my profile after numerous back and forth emails. Just to have it removed again. It eventually got reinstated AGAIN but they forced me to remove any language of my legitimate profession in the profile area that is about “WHAT YOU DO “. 

Because of this experience , once my subscription expired I didn’t renew it.

As a non paying member,  there are pay walls for almost every feature. They’ve basically become Grindr, but without the diversity. 

PSA! ~ 

PAYWALLS FOR SAFETY FEATURES ARE DANGEROUS.  

I have been a user for over 10 years and I had blocked a lot of people in that time. Some that felt dangerous, some that were abusive, and some just because I wanted discretion. 

Recently, this guy started stalking, threatening and using abusive language toward me. He even showed up on my street using their location filter.  

I tried blocking, but they put up a paywall so I couldn’t.  I tried reporting them and even wrote to customer service, but Scruff did nothing. They just sent me a generic email stating that I need to pay a membership in order to block people. 

So I quit.
